title: ManzaiSet: A Multimodal Dataset of Viewer Responses to Japanese Manzai Comedy

bias_targets.methodology: Creating a large-scale multimodal dataset of Japanese viewers' responses (facial video, audio, and ratings) to culturally specific Manzai comedy, and statistically analyzing viewer typologies and temporal dynamics to highlight non-Western emotional expression patterns and counteract Western-centric biases in affective computing datasets.
